title: 🛠️ **Stability Update & Bug Fixes**
body:
We've got a few pieces of good news to share regarding the server's stability and ongoing migration process.

────────────────────────
✅ **XP Loss Bug**
────────────────────────

It's been a while since the bug where players could lose XP when switching servers has happened.

After a lot of testing, it looks like we've finally found the cause and fixed it. At this point, we believe the issue has been **solved or at least heavily minimized**.

⚠️ If it ever happens to you again, please let us know:
• The exact hour and minute it happened.
• Your time zone (or country).

This information is extremely helpful for tracking down rare synchronization issues.

────────────────────────
🔑 **Crate Keys & Item Restoration**
────────────────────────

Crate keys purchased from shops should now work correctly every time.

Additionally, if a custom item ever becomes corrupted, you can now simply use:

➡️ **/restoreitems**

Previously, this wasn't possible for crate keys, so this gives the server an extra layer of stability.

────────────────────────
🛠️ **Crafting Permission Fixes**
────────────────────────

We've also fixed an issue where a few custom items could not be crafted because certain jobs were not being granted the correct permissions.

If you previously met all the requirements for an item but still couldn't craft it, it should now work correctly.

────────────────────────
📚 **New Server Guides**
────────────────────────

We've started adding guides to help explain custom crafting recipes and server mechanics.

The first one available covers **Solid XP**:

https://www.remocraft.com/guides/survival_towny/solid_xp.html

Many more guides will be added over time.

────────────────────────
⚔️ **BedWars Fixes**
────────────────────────

We've fixed several small bugs in the BedWars arenas that could cause:
• Lag while playing.
• Money loss under certain circumstances.

────────────────────────
✨ **Solid XP is back!**
────────────────────────

Solid XP and other XP-consuming items are working again!

This one took quite a while to solve, but we've finally managed to get everything working properly. Sorry for the inconvenience it caused.

────────────────────────
🔨 **Current Priorities**
────────────────────────

Right now we're focusing our efforts on fixing two remaining issues:

• A bug where money can disappear when depositing into a Land.
• A translation bug where interacting with NPCs displays a strange message instead of the proper translated text.

We're currently waiting for responses from the plugin developers. If we don't receive support within a reasonable time, we'll look for alternative solutions, even if that means purchasing additional plugins.

As always, thank you for your patience and for continuing to help us improve RemoCraft ❤️
author: RemoCraft Announcements

title: 📢✨ **Crafting & Enchantments System Update** ✨📢
body:
To improve the crafting system and prevent the issues we've been experiencing, we have had to **completely rebuild the enchantment slot system**.

────────────────────────
🛠️ **New Item Restoration System**
────────────────────────

➡️ **/restoreitems**

This command will detect all custom items in your inventory and automatically restore them.

⚠️ **Exceptions:**
• Items that already have enchantments applied.
• Items with Armor Trims.
• Items whose maximum enchantment slots have been modified.

────────────────────────
🔮 **Enchanter Improvements**
────────────────────────

The **Enchanter** job now correctly detects custom enchantments.

────────────────────────
🌐 **New Official Website**
────────────────────────

**www.remocraft.com**

We will use it to publish announcements, guides, important links, and other server information.

────────────────────────
⚡ **New Enchantment Slot System**
────────────────────────

• You now need **250 levels** instead of 500.
• The **Luck** system still works.
• Once you obtain the result, the item will have a **100% chance to add the slot**.

Previously, it was possible to obtain items that only added the slot with reduced chances, such as **10%**.

➡️ **Shift + right-click** an enchanting table to view an item's slot count.

────────────────────────
🐛 **Bug Reports**
────────────────────────

If you find any bugs or strange behavior, please report them.

Thank you for your patience and for helping improve RemoCraft ❤️
